input: What has Salesforce changed in Agentforce pricing in 2026?

output.question: What has Salesforce changed in Agentforce pricing in 2026?
output.answer: Salesforce made two big Agentforce pricing changes in 2026. First, on September 3, 2026 it replaced the Enterprise, Unlimited and Agentforce 1 editions with Core, Advanced and Max editions. They cost $195, $395 and $550 per user per month and come with 500,000, 1 million and 2.75 million Flex Credits. Max stays at the Agentforce 1 price, and Agentforce 1 customers can upgrade to Max at no extra cost. Salesforce says pricing for existing customers on legacy editions stays the same, and new Industry Editions pricing takes effect 'later this fall'. Second, on June 25, 2026 it announced the Agentforce Help Agent with pay-per-resolution pricing. You pay only when the agent fully resolves an issue on its own, which CIO reports as $2 per successful resolution with a minimum of 1,000 resolutions. This model became available in July 2026. In early October a pricing tracker saw the 'Agentforce 1 Editions' card renamed to 'Agentforce Max Editions' and its Flex Credit limit raised from 2.5M to 2.75M per org per year.

key_facts.fact: On September 3, 2026 Salesforce launched Core, Advanced and Max editions for Agentforce Sales, Service and Industries.
Prices are Core $195, Advanced $395 and Max $550 per user per month. Max costs the same as the Agentforce 1 Edition.
Flex Credits included: Core 500,000, Advanced 1 million, Max 2.75 million.
Pricing for existing customers on legacy editions is unchanged. Agentforce 1 customers can upgrade to Max at no extra cost, which Salesforce values at up to $500 in added value.
New pricing for Agentforce Industry Editions takes effect 'later this fall', with no exact date given.
According to Concret.io, Core replaces Enterprise (was $175, about 11.4% higher) and Advanced replaces Unlimited (was $350, about 12.9% higher). Starter and Pro Suite are unchanged.
The Agentforce Help Agent is billed per resolution. There is no charge if the customer asks for a human or leaves unhappy. It became generally available in July 2026.
The price is $2 per successful resolution, and prepurchased resolution packs have a 1,000-resolution minimum.

Between September 28 and October 5, 2026 the pricing page renamed 'Agentforce 1 Editions' to 'Agentforce Max Editions' and raised the Flex Credits limit from 2.5M to 2.75M per org per year. A later change kept Max at $550.

caveats: Sources disagree on how many Flex Credits Agentforce 1 included before the change. Concret.io says 1M per org per year, while the PricingSaaS tracker says 2.5M before the October rise to 2.75M.
The $2-per-resolution figure comes from CIO's coverage. The SalesforceBen article I opened does not state a dollar amount, and I did not open Salesforce's own Help Agent announcement.
The old Enterprise ($175) and Unlimited ($350) prices, and the size of the increases, come from a third-party blog (Concret.io), not from Salesforce.
Industry Editions pricing was due 'later this fall'. I did not confirm whether it has taken effect as of November 10, 2026.
Earlier pricing models (Flex Credits per action, per-conversation pricing) may still be on offer alongside these changes. Check the live pricing page and your contract terms.
